compute_fpfh — 3D feature_register op

• Data kinds: points × normals → descriptor

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.compute_fpfh(points, normals, k=60, n_bins=11) (to call the implementation directly, import feat_fpfh; feat_fpfh.compute_fpfh(points, normals, k=60, n_bins=11); from the registry, ops3d.get("compute_fpfh"))

Usage

Compute the FPFH descriptor (N, 3*n_bins) (Rusu 2009).

1) SPFH: for each pair of a point p and its k neighbour points, compute (α,φ,θ) and histogram each feature into n_bins bins.

2) FPFH(p) = SPFH(p) + (1/k)Σ_j (1/d_pj) SPFH(j): combines the neighbour SPFHs with distance weights.

The 3 sub-histograms are each L1-normalised and concatenated (default 33 dimensions). The angular features are rigid-body invariant.

Arguments: points (N,3), normals (N,3), k (number of FPFH neighbours), n_bins (number of bins per 1 feature).

Returns: descriptor matrix of shape (N, 3*n_bins). Raises ValueError: if points/normals are not (N,3), row counts differ, values are non-finite, or N<4 (because k-NN requires k>=3).
